name: chemistry-sketcher

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @starter/chem-core run build && pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/client run build
scripts.build:client: pnpm --filter @starter/chem-core run build && pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/client run build
scripts.test: pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:client
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @starter/chem-core run build && pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm -r run typecheck

description: Chemical structure editor for publication figures
